subject: Orchid account capacity pathway & term extension opportunity
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sasha Levin <sasha@orchid.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orchid account capacity pathway & term extension opportunity

Hi Sasha —

Quick recap from our Q2 monitoring: Orchid’s production traffic increased steadily the last two months. Attached is the Q2 usage report, but the key numbers are: current monthly run-rate ~1.2B tokens, July spike pushed short-term peak to ~1.6B tokens/day on some workflows, and our forecast (based on your non-prod signals + marketing cadence) projects ~35–45% growth in the next quarter.

Given that trajectory, I wanted to propose two straightforward routes to lock in predictable economics and avoid throttling risk:

1) CapacityCommit: 18-month term, increase committed capacity to 1.8B tokens/month (next 12 months), 15% per-token discount vs current retail.
2) ShortFlex + Extension: 12-month extension at current commit with a $0.0035 blended token rate for overage buckets, with a small implementation credit to help offset migration of new workflows.

Attached: Q2-usage-report-OrchidAI.pdf and a short ROI deck that shows token-economics with the two options.

Can we schedule a 30-min call this week to walk the numbers with procurement? If you prefer, I can send a concise term sheet and DocuSign link after we align on the option.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: Q2-usage-report-OrchidAI.pdf (summary), Orchid-ROI-deck-2p.pdf (2 slides)

From: Sasha Levin <sasha@orchid.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchid account capacity pathway & term extension opportunity

Thanks Ben — really helpful to see the numbers. A couple of quick questions before we schedule:

• How would overage billing work if we go with the CapacityCommit option?
• We need SOC 2 evidence and the most recent data retention/audit logs summary for procurement.
• Is there any way to pilot the higher throughput for 30 days before committing?

Would be great to do a call Thursday morning PT.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sasha Levin <sasha@orchid.ai>, renewals@orchid.ai
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchid account capacity pathway & term extension opportunity — Proposal

Sasha — thanks for the quick reply.

Answers inline and a concrete proposal below:

• Overage under CapacityCommit: overages are billed monthly at 50% of retail rate (i.e., much cheaper than current overage). We also offer burst capacity for sustained peaks during onboarding windows (automated, no nav change).
• SOC2 & audits: attaching our SOC2 summary and data-retention doc (abridged). Will get you the full package via support portal if procurement requires it.
• Pilot: we can add a 30-day pilot clause to the term sheet — if you hit a defined throughput threshold and decide not to proceed, we’ll prorate and revert you to current rates with no penalty.

Proposal (summary):
• Option A — CapacityCommit: 18-month term; committed 1.8B tokens/month; 15% token discount; monthly committed billing; deal_id ORCH-2027-03.
• Option B — ShortFlex: 12-month extension at current commit, add a $10k implementation credit, blended overage rate $0.0035/token for overages.

Attached documents: Orchid-ROI-deck-2p.pdf, proposed-commit-pricing.csv, Q2-usage-report-OrchidAI.pdf

If Option A looks good I’ll route to contracts and generate a DocuSign envelope (link below). Proposed timeline: sign week of Aug 2, onboarding and capacity ramp week of Aug 9–16.

DocuSign preview (read-only): https://docusign.com/link/ORCH-2027-03-sign

Next step: confirm which option (A/B) and your preferred sign date. I’ll also add a 30-day pilot clause to the contract per your ask.

Best,
Ben
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Orchid-ROI-deck-2p.pdf, proposed-commit-pricing.csv, Q2-usage-report-OrchidAI.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Orchid account capacity pathway & term extension opportunity — internal: approval request

Team — forwarding the thread with Orchid. Short ask: to win the 18-month capacity commit (Option A) we may need to concede a little on list discount and offer a $10k implementation credit and the 30-day pilot clause. Numbers: committing 1.8B tokens/month at 15% off retail yields a predictable ARR uplift ~ $720k (net of the credit in year one). The account is headed for sustained higher throughput — risk of them throttling or moving to multi-vendor approach if we don’t provide capacity certainty.

Specific approvals requested:
1) Allow 15% off list for an 18-month commit and accept the $10k onboarding credit (one-time).
2) Approve the 30-day pilot clause to be included in the DocuSign envelope.
3) If procurement pushes for 12-mo vs 18-mo, authorize a counter: 12-mo at 12% discount.

Can you confirm by EOD Monday so I can lock the Aug 2 sign date?

—Ben

Please proceed to prepare the term sheet and send the DocuSign envelope. Loop Legal for standard SOW addendum and attach the SOC2 summary we mentioned earlier. Keep Marissa in the loop for onboarding scheduling.
